header: Days and hours as a description list
text: Day and time pairs in a real dl element. One to ten rows, each with an optional line of text under the hours.
note: No day is marked as today and there is no 'open now' state: a cached page could still say 'open' at midnight. Put exceptions in this note.

rows.title: Monday – Thursday
rows.text: This line under the hours is optional

rows.title: Saturday, Sunday & public holidays
rows.text: Switching a row off shows 'Closed' and strikes typed hours through
